mechanism: Rifampin is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inducer that increases metabolism of enalapril and its active metabolite enalaprilat, reducing antihypertensive efficacy.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and consider increasing enalapril dose or switching to an ACE inhibitor with less hepatic metabolism; recheck BP control after rifampin initiation or discontinuation.
